{{Top|leg}}
'''Jeph Shannessi''' was a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="RoE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>

He was instrumental in the Alliance's success on the planet [[Minntaa]]. Unfortunately, when he was successfully killed by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] less than twelve meters from his base camp, the war on Minntaa turned in the Imperial military's favor.<ref name="RoE" />
